description: Under review: the per-country category mix of nationally blocked domains (political speech, regulated morality, circumvention tooling) comes from Voidly's national blocklist layer, which let false positives through in open countries and is being rebuilt with a stricter rule, so it is withheld. Returns the bucket definitions, null country rows and a review object with the layer's window end as the data date. Pass country=XX for one country.
